# e2e/genmatrix.py turns this file into the workflow matrix, so adding a
# protocol is a one-line change HERE and nothing else.
# The driver is chosen from what the script ACTUALLY invokes (verified by

# reading each e2e/scripts/

.sh), not from the protocol's name.
# `host` = the ubuntu-latest runner itself (git, go, python3, curl, wget, tar,
# and the setup-* steps the workflow installs).

# /artifacts/git/<host>/<repo>.git. That suite is therefore DROPPED here, and

column1: # Dropped, with the reason recorded instead of a permanently red cell. Each of
# these was tried and failed for an environmental reason, NOT because the
#   oci       Pure passthrough (no local copy). The request sits for the full
#             2-minute timeout and ends 404 because this runner cannot reach
#             registry-1.docker.io. Nothing to do with the adapter; the OCI
#             paths are covered by oci/adapter_test.go and the other suites.
#   luarocks  Same shape: only a target entry pointing at luarocks.org, so the
#             suite is a plain fetch from that host, which times out here.
#   nix       The Nix installer needs sudo (or a systemd daemon). A job
#             container is root but has no sudo, and pre-creating /nix is not
#             enough: the installer still exits without producing a binary.
#   git       No git protocol in this repository (only gitlfs).
#   gitlfs    The adapter serves ONLY the LFS object protocol; gitlfs.sh does a
